effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] ＜Blitz＞ (If your opponent has 1 or more memory, this Digimon may attack.)
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend this Digimon.
[All Turns] When an opponent's effect would delete this Digimon or return it to the hand or deck, by trashing 1 level 6 Digimon card in this Digimon's digivolution cards, prevent it from leaving play.
